implementationNotes: Keep current trainee distinct from selected stored Pokémon. There is only one training slot.
Selecting a row/card changes the preview without swapping. Train first opens inline confirmation; explicit Train applies the existing swap, Cancel preserves state.
The current trainee banks through the existing storage path and keeps progress; no release, delete, trade or Focus-start action is introduced.
Eggs use the same Train and confirmation flow; do not add immediate hatch or invented incubation progress.
Real species names, sprites, stage metadata, entries and IDs must come from actual saved data. Mock quantities and species are illustrative.
Keep identity, actions and confirmation context in the main canvas when optional extras collapse.
Preserve the existing quiet Ditto empty-storage state; that state is not separately mocked here.
All approved resting sidebar/major section boundaries remain line-free even if incidental local component strokes appear in generated references.
Option 1 depicts an expanded confirmation. Options 2 and 3 depict the resting state before confirmation.
